newsitem.title: USA: CME AUG, OCT BONELESS BEEF DOWN LIMIT, CASH WEAK.
newsitem.headline: CME AUG, OCT BONELESS BEEF DOWN LIMIT, CASH WEAK.

text.p: CME August and October boneless beef futures were down the three cent limit at mid-morning on selling linked to weakness in the cash market.
Floor sources said locals and Dean Witter were featured sellers amid talk of trade in the cash market at around 93 to 94 cents a lb, versus around 101 cents on Tuesday.
At 1044 CDT August was down the three cent limit at 97.40 cents a lb with October also down three cents at 92.50 cents.
